title: Efficacy and Safety Study of Norethindrone Acetate Transdermal Delivery System in Contraception
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to determine whether NEA TDS is effective in the prevention of pregnancy. The safety of this product will also be evaluated.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Healthy females
* 18-45 years
* Regular, consistent menstrual cycles between 25 and 35 days
* Sexually active and at risk of becoming pregnant

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of infertility
* Known contraindications to progestogen administration
* Pap smear suggestive of a high-grade precancerous lesion(s)
* Clinically significant deviation from normal in any of the screening tests or exams
